ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between low-intensity black peripheral regions and high-intensity white mid-lobe patches (~40% white, 60% black visibility).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a broad white field with dense, vertical-diagonal black linear mottling. Right lobe contains a white field concentrated in the outer-distal quadrant with sparse black spotting. Lower lobes and central peduncle area are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree angle at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with low pixel-amplitude along both lobes. A distinct larger indentation is visible approximately 30% along the length of the right trailing edge moving outward from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping concave curves along the trailing edge, terminating in sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several isolated high-intensity circular white spots (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) are visible on the lower-right dark region of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, roughly parallel linear streaks (rake marks) intersect the white pigmentation patches on both lobes, primarily oriented from the mid-lobe toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe exhibits an irregular, jagged protrusion/fringe that deviates from the smooth taper observed on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency black speckling within the white patch of the left lobe creates a unique high-contrast textural field not mirrored on the right lobe.
